Name: Blue Star Irregulars
Description: A mercenary command formed out of SLDF veterans who didn't join the Exodus, the Blue Star Irregulars are named after a military decoration created and issued by General Kerensky, the Blue Star. Their original commander called for all veterans who had received the medal to join him in forming a new unit to honor the memory of the SLDF. Since its formation the Irregulars have been mostly under the employ of House Davion.
